// You have come across a half-finished calculator put together by Kant D. Bugg. Kant has managed to figure out how to select one of the input tags on the page and output it to the text field within the calculator, but he hasn’t figured out how to make all of the buttons operational. See if you can help him finish this project!

let width = 300;
let height = 400;

const svg = d3.select("#calculator")
  .append("svg")
  .attr("width", width)
  .attr("height", height)
  .attr("margin", "0 auto")

svg.append("rect")
  .attr("fill", "black")
  .attr("id", "calculator")
  .attr("x", 50)
  .attr("y", 75)
  .attr("width", 200)
  .attr("height", 300);

svg.append("rect")
  .attr("fill", "white")
  .attr("x", 75)
  .attr("y", 100)
  .attr("width", 150)
  .attr("height", 30);

svg.append("text")
  .attr("id", "output")
  .attr("fill", "black")
  .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
  .attr("x", 150)
  .attr("y", 120)

svg.append("input")
  .attr("type", "text")
  .attr("id", "number-one")

d3.select("#add")
  .on("click", () => {
    let valueOne = d3.select('#number').property("value");
    d3.select('#output').text(valueOne);
  })

// Make a carnival-style application which selects a random number between 0 and 500 on the click of a button. Find 5 different images which represent 5 different levels of prizes that the person can win based on what the number is. Also, display a message which tells the person what they won.
